members.reason: [llm] duplicates #1996: Streamable HTTP JSON response mode rejects requests whose Accept header only lists application/json (previously required both application/json AND text/event-stream to be present), causing valid JSON-only clients to get a 406 error.

clusters.desc: Streamable HTTP JSON response mode rejects requests whose Accept header only lists application/json (previously required both application/json AND text/event-stream to be present), causing valid JSON-only clients to get a 406 error. (2 PRs)

clusters.pick_reason: #2215 is titled as a fix (not chore) because it addresses a real behavioral bug: shouldAttemptFallback still compared against the old '/' sentinel after normalization, causing redundant fallback attempts on root paths. #2214 only normalizes the trailing-slash stripping and doesn't touch shouldAttemptFallback, so it leaves that inconsistency in place. #2215 also introduces a single normalizeDiscoveryPath() helper reused across call sites instead of inlining the same regex twice as #2214 does, reducing duplicate logic in the file.

members.title: chore(client): normalize trailing slashes in discovery paths
members.author: raashish1601
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2215: Both rewrite the same trailing-slash-stripping logic inside buildWellKnownPath (packages/client/src/client/auth.ts) to fix malformed/incorrect discovery-path construction: #2214 (chore) switches the single `.endsWith('/')` strip to a `replace(/\/+$/, '')` regex so multiple trailing slashes collapse fully, applying that same regex fix in both buildWellKnownPath and buildDiscoveryUrls. #2215 (fix) makes the identical regex change but factors it into a new normalizeDiscoveryPath() helper used by buildWellKnownPath, and goes further by also correcting shouldAttemptFallback's root-path check (`pathname === '/'` -> `pathname === ''`), which was left inconsistent by the same normalization change and caused redundant/incorrect fallback attempts on root-like paths.
